data.name: Fritze
data.gender_notes: Fritze is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German 'frid' meaning 'peace' and 'thi' meaning 'people' or 'god'. In the Middle Ages, Fritze was a unisex name. However, it is now predominantly used as a feminine name. In Germanic mythology, Fritze was the name of a goddess of peace and fertility. The name Fritze carries the meaning “Peaceful strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fritze usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Fritze belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fritze total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
